label: Backward Euler capacitor
subgoals: Replace the derivative by the backward difference over one step
Read the conductance as C over h
Read the history current as C over h times the previous voltage

label: Trapezoidal capacitor
subgoals: Write the trapezoidal update for the capacitor voltage
Solve it for the current at the new time point
Read off the conductance and the history current with the previous current

label: Recovering the capacitor current
subgoals: Take the voltage change over the accepted step
Multiply it by two C over h
Subtract the previous current to get the new one
